entities.summary: Boris Nikolaevich Pastukhov was a Soviet and Russian diplomat and politician and a Komsomol member. Following the dissolution of the Soviet Union he was a member of the State Duma of the third and the fourth convocations. He was also a member of the Soviet of the Union of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR (1966–1989) representing the Chelyabinsk Oblast.
